items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Because he, the last time I played with Carroll Dickerson was when we came here to New York in '29.

ctx.x: No. I don't remember that. Because he, the last time I played with Carroll Dickerson was when we came here to New York in '29. We were at Conrey's Inn. That's when Louis quit the band.
Well then was the Three Deuces next then? What about this New Deal Club he mentions?
